# assignmentB2AlheriAyasal

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

The goal of assignmentB2AlheriAyasal is to find the highest and lowest values in a numeric vector and also report their position. It handles missing values and checks for non-numeric input, empty vectors and vectors that contain only missing values.


## Installation

You can install the development version of assignmentB2AlheriAyasal from [GitHub](https://github.com/UBC-STAT545-F2026/AssignmentB2AyasalAlheri.git) with:

``` r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("UBC-STAT545-F2026/AssignmentB2AyasalAlheri")
```

## Example

This is a basic example which shows you how to find the highest and lowest values and their positions:


```{r example}
library(assignmentB2AlheriAyasal)
 highest_lowest_value(c(3,8,NA,15))
```
